sources.entry: DeepTranslate - Multi-API browser plugin (GPT, Claude, etc.). #free

summary.name: DeepTranslate
summary.one_liner: A browser extension listed on the Chrome Web Store as a multi-API translation plugin that can use models such as GPT and Claude.
use_cases: use GPT or Claude for translation
summary.what_it_does: The page is a Chrome Web Store listing page, but the captured text is mostly the store's general landing content (featured extensions, categories, promotions) and does not describe DeepTranslate's features. The only DeepTranslate-specific information comes from the listing note: it is a multi-API browser plugin that supports GPT, Claude and other APIs, tagged as free. Details such as supported languages, setup steps or how the API keys work are not present in the page text.
notable: Multi-API design supporting GPT, Claude, and other APIs
Listed in a curated collective AI tools collection under Translation
caveats: Page text is mostly generic Chrome Web Store content; DeepTranslate's own features are not described
The 'free' tag comes from the listing note, not the page itself, and underlying model API costs may apply (unverified)
